details: The US Federal Reserve maintained interest rates at 3.5-3.75% in a fractured 9-3 vote, with three members advocating for a rate hike. This hawkish tone and lack of clear forward guidance are causing investor anxiety, leading to a sell-off in global stock markets and a rise in US Treasury yields. The uncertainty about future monetary policy decisions, particularly the possibility of rates remaining elevated longer, is dampening risk appetite across traditional assets.
title: Federal Reserve's Hawkish Hold Fuels Market Uncertainty

details: Renewed military exchanges between the United States and Iran, including Iranian missile attacks on US forces and retaliatory strikes by the US and Saudi Arabia, have significantly heightened geopolitical risks in the Middle East. This escalation has caused Brent crude oil prices to climb, fueling concerns over global energy supplies and inflationary pressures, and increasing risk aversion across financial markets.
title: Escalating US-Iran Tensions Drive Oil Prices Up

details: The European Union has adopted its 21st sanctions package against Russia, broadening restrictions across various sectors. Notably, for the first time, the package introduces the possibility of a full third-country ban on cryptocurrency services and expands transaction prohibitions to additional Russian and third-country banks for facilitating sanctions circumvention. This move aims to tighten the enforcement of sanctions and prevent the use of crypto assets to evade them.
title: EU Expands Russia Sanctions, Includes Crypto Service Ban

details: The President's Working Group on Digital Asset Markets is scheduled to release its long-awaited crypto policy report today, July 30, 2026. This report, mandated by President Trump's executive order, is anticipated to lay out regulatory and legislative recommendations concerning stablecoins, market structure, oversight, consumer protection, and potentially proposals for a national digital asset stockpile and a strategic Bitcoin reserve.
title: White House Crypto Report Due Today, May Include Bitcoin Reserve Plans

details: India's Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has released guidance on crypto-asset reporting obligations, aligning the country's tax framework with the OECD's Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF). This initiative seeks to curb tax evasion, enhance data-driven tax administration, and harmonize India's standards with international norms. The framework covers relevant crypto-assets and reporting service providers for both domestic and cross-border transactions.
title: India Aligns Crypto Reporting with OECD Standards

details: The "Clarity Act," a bill designed to establish a clear regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies in the US, is encountering significant obstacles in the Senate. Concerns have arisen due to President Donald Trump's disclosed $1.4 billion in crypto ventures in 2025, raising ethics questions. Additionally, banking lobbying groups are opposing provisions that would allow crypto companies to offer interest-like payments on stablecoins, fearing it could divert bank deposits.
title: US Crypto Clarity Act Faces Hurdles in Senate
